title: About
intro: Whether you're acquiring your first piece or expanding an established collection, every decision is grounded in the contemporary landscape: what matters, what will last, and what's been overlooked.
approach: Our approach goes beyond the transaction. We provide insight into each artist's practice by tracking career trajectories and market trends. We guide clients through each decision, ensuring thoughtful, meaningful acquisitions.
closing: From curation and sourcing to market analysis and collection management, we support private clients, institutions, and corporations at every stage. We don't advise on speculation. We advise on significance.
founderBio: Talia Pockhai is an art advisor and collector based between London and Miami. With nearly two decades of collecting experience, a Masters from Sotheby's Institute of Art, and deep relationships across the global gallery and institutional landscape, Talia brings a rare combination of insider knowledge and passion to every client engagement. Her perspective is informed by research, global art travel and a commitment to championing artists whose work deserves far greater recognition.
founderQuote:
I started collecting nearly two decades ago and spent years navigating an art world that wasn't built for everyone. Finding artists who spoke directly to me — who reflected my history, my curiosity, my sense of beauty — took years of searching. That search became a career. Now I do it for you.

Every recommendation I make is rooted in deep research — into the artists I source as much as into my clients. The result is a collection that is a true reflection of you and your journey.
